historical_record.description: The 75-by-100-foot lot held a three-level parking garage used for storage, monthly and occasional parking and some repairs — about 40 cars, half of them unregistered and stored — a nonconforming use due to end in 1980; San Francisco University High School proposed to buy it and convert it into classrooms, studios and a gymnasium.

The City Planning Commission approved, 4-2, San Francisco University High School's conversion of the garage into classrooms, studios and a gymnasium, capping enrollment at 325, requiring soundproofing and keeping evening events at its Jackson Street building (Resolution 7503).
